verdict.rationale: Docs state SDKs are generated from an OpenAPI spec and that the MCP integration lets AI assistants query the 'live OpenAPI spec' directly (kintsugi-docs-10, kintsugi-docs-18), implying a machine-readable spec exists, but a direct probe for standard OpenAPI/Swagger file locations returned 404 everywhere (kintsugi-probe-2), so there's no confirmed public download endpoint. Missing for 10: a verifiable direct download link/endpoint for the OpenAPI file and independent confirmation it's accessible outside the MCP/SDK tooling.
